//: ONE typecheck over the whole tree. `lib` carries DOM because PR 2 put a browser in this repo: `packages/web-ui` renders one, and `@kolu/surface`'s Solid half — which the browser and the daemon's own listener both reach — names `window`, `document` and `WebSocket`. Splitting into two projects would type the node half without DOM at the cost of two `tsc` passes and a second config to keep true; the trade taken here is one pass and one config, and the cost is that a node module CAN name `document`. That is a real loss, and the fence against it is the per-package closure tests: a node package that imported a browser module would fail its own wall before anybody noticed the global.
